summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature test of the Supplier Portal Swiss High-Contrast redesign + new Audits & QC page for H1330 (test@test.com/Test123). Login, persistent left sidebar shell (dashboard/shipments/documents/audits-qc nav items), KPI bento cards, mobile hamburger drawer, cross-page navigation, demo-data banner, QMS metrics row, both tabs (Q-Notifications + Audit NCs), CAP validation error on empty submit, successful CAP submit + persistence across full page reload (GET /api/supplier-portal/caps returns the new row) all verified end-to-end. No blocking bugs found.

issues: Active POs / Outstanding Qty / In-Transit KPI cards show 0 while POs are still loading (Loading your Purchase Orders... visible). They do update once /purchase-orders resolves, but a brief '0' flash is visible for ~1-2s. Minor - consider a skeleton state on the KPI numbers instead of showing 0.

critical_code_review_comments: SupplierAuditsPage.jsx: pendingCapCount = 11 while the page only surfaces 6 Q-Notifications + 5 NCs (11 rows total) - i.e. the metric currently counts EVERY not-yet-CAPped open row regardless of whether it's already Closed. Filter looks correct on read (q.status !== 'Closed') but you may want to double-check the mock data's Closed rows so the CAP-Pending KPI doesn't overstate. Not a blocker.

Dashboard KPI cards default to 0 while data is loading which visually flickers - consider showing '-' or a small skeleton until both /purchase-orders and /shipments resolve, since the user requested 'sensible non-crashing numbers'.
SupplierPortalLayout.jsx line 41: data-testid mapping uses inline ternary (`audits` -> `audits-qc`). Works, but a small map { audits: 'audits-qc' } is cleaner and easier to extend.
test_credentials: test@test.com / Test123 (vendor_code H1330). A CAP row was persisted for QN-911-1 (reference_type=q_notification) during this run - safe to leave, main agent said either leave or they will clean up.
seed_data_creation: One real CAP submission was POSTed to MongoDB collection supplier_cap_submissions: reference_type=q_notification, reference_id=QN-911-1, vendor_code H1330. Verified persistent across full page reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar shell (SupplierPortalLayout) is shared across Dashboard/Shipments/Documents/Audits pages - nav data-testids are nav-dashboard, nav-shipments, nav-documents, nav-audits-qc. Mobile hamburger toggle is supplier-mobile-nav-toggle (< md). Sonner Toaster is mounted globally in App.js. CAP endpoints POST/GET /api/supplier-portal/caps are LIVE and persist. Q-Notifications/Audit-NC data itself is deterministic frontend mock (qmsMockData.js) - do NOT flag that.
rca of the issue: N/A - no failing flow. The one flaky-looking observation (nav-dashboard/nav-shipments returning is_visible=False in the very first check right after login, before the sidebar mount settled) is a Playwright non-auto-waiting is_visible race, not a product bug - screenshots and subsequent clicks on the same selectors succeeded, confirming the elements are correctly in the DOM and interactive.
